chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: The batch readiness commit must be no later than the earliest candidate_feature_cutoff_time, and every source event and receipt must be at or before its race cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.denominator_rule: Unsupported, late, missing, stale, and schedule-invalid races remain represented as deterministic failed or NO_BET records.
chronological_fold_design.design: One deterministic synthetic contract suite with ten pre-registered cases; no fitting, model comparison, threshold search, ROI calculation, or real-data access.
chronological_fold_design.quote_clock: At most three pre-registered attempts occur inside the locked T-3:30 to T-3:00 window. Only a quote satisfying all existing strict as-of and 60-second freshness assertions may be latched.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: APPROVED_TO_PREPARE permits synthetic fixture tests only.
chronological_fold_design.schedule_clock: A schedule-only observation is locked before any odds request. If a new schedule version arrives prospectively, poll-open and cutoff are recomputed from that version without rounding.

proposal_scope.data_as_of: 2026-08-02T23:30:00+09:00. Proposal construction used only contract status, race-domain, schedule, and source-time evidence from EXP010 and EXP011. Odds values, results, payouts, ROI, and candidate alternatives are forbidden from implementation and test selection.
proposal_scope.hypothesis: A research-only contract layer can retain every registered race while preventing obstacle or unknown race domains from entering the flat-race model, requiring the candidate batch before the earliest cutoff, deriving poll times from a separately locked current schedule, and retrying only within the fixed T-3:30 to T-3:00 window until a quote satisfies the unchanged 60-second freshness contract.
in_scope: Add a premeeting batch-readiness assertion against the earliest candidate cutoff
Add a schedule-only preflight observation that cannot return or expose odds
Add a single fixed bounded polling policy inside T-3:30 through T-3:00
Add an explicit allowlist for flat turf and dirt race domains and retain unsupported rows as UNSUPPORTED_RACE_TYPE failures
Add race-domain metadata and its source hash to the candidate source manifest and immutable candidate packet
Derive poll-open and cutoff timestamps from the locked schedule version without minute rounding
Keep the strict maximum quote age and ingestion delay at 60 seconds
Retain every registered target as a deterministic candidate, failure, or NO_BET row
Use synthetic fixtures only during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
lineage_hash_requirements: Candidate and quote ledgers remain append-only and idempotent
Candidate identity and candidate-freeze hash are unchanged across all schedule and quote attempts
Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
Every quote attempt records its request, source, receive, and selected-asof timestamps even when rejected
Race-domain metadata is derived from the same pre-race entry snapshot and bound into the source-record hash
The locked schedule record is hash-verified and referenced by every quote attempt
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The observed unsupported-race candidate, late source rows, schedule-shift poll-window failures, and stale one-shot quotes cannot all be eliminated without changing the model, relaxing the strict quote contract, reading odds before the permitted window, dropping failed races, or touching a production/order path.
out_of_scope: Any alternative pair or ticket search after odds access
Any model, feature, calibrator, confidence threshold, candidate pair, or expected-return threshold change
Any obstacle-race model or attempt to reuse the flat-race model for obstacle races
Any production dashboard, notification, credential, purchase adapter, target handoff, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any real race-day execution during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
Any relaxation or retrospective reinterpretation of the 60-second strict quote freshness contract
Any result, payout, popularity, market rank, final odds, ROI, or post-race feature

primary_metric.baseline: EXP011 retained all 36 rows but produced one unsupported obstacle candidate, 11 late source failures, 2 schedule-shift poll-window failures, and 18 stale one-shot quote failures.
primary_metric.evaluation: Fraction of the ten fixed synthetic cases producing the exact expected terminal status while all safety and chronology invariants pass.
primary_metric.name: pre_registered_contract_case_pass_fraction

purge_embargo.candidate_embargo: No candidate may be created, replaced, or re-ranked after odds access.
purge_embargo.quote_embargo: No quote source, receive, or selected-asof timestamp after T-3 is eligible.
purge_embargo.result_embargo: No result, payout, final odds, or ROI information is available to the implementation.
purge_embargo.schedule_embargo: A schedule update received after its newly implied strict cutoff cannot be applied retrospectively and must fail closed.

proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The frozen Top3 model was trained for flat turf and dirt races, so obstacle and unknown domains are out of distribution and must fail closed. Candidate probabilities must exist before price observation. Schedule timing determines when a quote is legally observable, and repeated bounded observations inside the pre-registered 30-second window can select the newest quote available by T-3 without changing the candidate or freshness threshold.

rejection_gate: Any candidate batch committed after the earliest cutoff is accepted as a complete batch
Any candidate pair changes after odds access
Any obstacle or unknown race domain reaches model inference or CANDIDATE_READY
Any odds endpoint is accessed before the locked schedule poll-open time
Any poll or cutoff timestamp is rounded to a clock minute
Any production, dashboard, notification, credential, purchase, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order side effect occurs
Any quote older than 60 seconds or received after T-3 is accepted
Any registered target disappears from the ledger
Any schedule update is applied retrospectively after its new cutoff
stop_conditions: A credential, login challenge, CAPTCHA, access restriction, protected endpoint, or order-capable path is encountered
A model, feature, calibrator, candidate, confidence, or expected-return policy change would be required
A real race-day row or external quote would need to be accessed during preparation
Any safety flag cannot remain false or stake cannot remain zero
The strict 60-second quote contract would need to be relaxed
proposal_scope.target_population: Synthetic fixtures representing supported flat turf and dirt races, an obstacle race, an unknown race domain, an early and late candidate batch, exact and shifted odd-minute schedules, a late schedule update, a 90-second-old provider quote, and a fully valid strict-T3 path. No new real race-day run is authorized by this proposal.
proposal_scope.title: Harden race-day domain, source-readiness, schedule, and quote-poll contracts
